description: Classic Mode is the first and oldest game mode in Mobile Legends. All other game modes use the Classic rules as a basis. This mode offers the 5v5 and Mobile Legends experience without fear of losing your rank, but your win rate will be affected, both on the hero side and overall.​​​​ Classic mode is suitable for beginners who need to familiarize themselves with Mobile Legends games. You can freely choose any hero you own, as well as free weekly heroes and any trial cards you own. However, you cannot have more than one hero in your team. You can also choose the hero you like, since there is no hero ban unlike Ranked mode.

elements.texte: Like all MOBA games, the main objective is to destroy the enemy base. This requires you to defend your turrets and base and destroy theirs. Each turret in a specific lane must be destroyed in sequence for your minions to reach the base. There are ways to destroy turrets by using minions/creeps to take damage from turret bullets. After destroying the turrets, you will be able to damage/destroy the enemy base. Destroying the last turret in a lane will grant super minions that deal high damage to heroes and clear lanes faster. Sometimes players are forced to rack up kills against enemy heroes instead of focusing on enemy minions and turrets. More kills might get them MVP and farming, but destroying the turrets, accessing the enemy base and destroying it is the main objective.

Celestial Palace/Western Expanse — A field inspired by the Defense of the Ancients: Allstars (DOTA for short) version of the map, with several features and mechanics changed. The game consists of five heroes from each team, who are then placed in an arena with the goal of destroying everyone's base inhibitor, resulting in a victory. The typical time it takes to complete most games is around 10-15 minutes, but some games can last over 30 minutes.
The battlefield is divided into three lanes to fight your way to the enemy base.

A jungle populated with jungle monsters grants healing buffs, role buffs, and gold buffs when defeated. There are also Boss Monsters that provide gold for your entire team or the Lord fighting alongside you.
The Golden Path can also be taken by Tanks moving for the team to quickly obtain items to support the team.

description: Ranked is a competitive queue game mode. Players earn or lose stars if they win or lose in this mode. Warrior, Elite, Master, Grandmaster, Epic, Legend and Mythic (Mythical Honor, Mythical Glory and Mythical Immortal) are the seven ranks of Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.

elements.texte: Players can choose three heroes to feature in their lobby and draft phase. These heroes must be played at least once in a row.

Players can play solo or form a team of two, three, or five players to queue up. Players can invite other players of a higher or lower rank than them to the lobby. A team of four people is not permitted.
When a team with players of different ranks queues, it is called Flex Rank, and they will only queue the matches of the highest ranked person.
Examples:
A Mythic player teams up with an Epic player, both will follow the Mythic player's draft rule.

A Mythic Glory player teams up with a Grandmaster player and a Legend player, all of whom will follow the Mythic player draft rule, although Draft Pick is not normally available to players below Epic rank.
However, a player in solo queue may find themselves matchmaking with higher or lower ranked allies, this can be triggered by the following:
Allies play as a team while you are solo. Among the allies of said team is at least one player of similar rank to yours.
Example: An Epic player teams up with a Legend player and you, an Epic player, can meet them.
All players are playing solo, but the enemy team has someone with a similar rank to you.
Example: Your rank is Legend, but 4 of your teammates are Mythic. So at least one of the enemies is Legend.
When this phenomenon occurs, it is possible that only one team member is in a different rank.
Example: Your team has 4 players at Legend rank and 1 player at Mythic rank, this means the enemy team can have 1-4 players at Mythic rank, but there must be someone at Epic rank.

Thanks to this Flex Rank mechanic, even a solo player from Legend I can queue with an ally from Epic V, as they are just a different rank, but the gap is very different, leading to the widely perceived dark system.
A quick matchmaking option will be offered if the queue is taking too long, this option will match you even with players you blocked previously.
If the player you blocked teams up with someone you don't block, you can still queue with them during the match.

When a player reaches Epic V or higher (Grandmaster V or higher in Advanced Server), Draft Pick becomes available for future matches. Unlike Blind Pick, Draft Pick allows both teams to see their heroes during their selection, and allows up to 10 banned heroes (3/4/5 bans in Epic/Legend/Mythic) for each team for balancing purposes. Heroes already selected or banned cannot be chosen for the duration of the match.
There are seven ranks in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. They are: Warrior, Elite, Master, Grandmaster, Epic, Legendary and Mythical.

Each rank has divisions written in Roman numerals and a certain number of stars necessary to be promoted to the next division or rank. If a player exceeds the maximum number of stars in their current division or falls below zero stars, they can move to the next division or return to the previous division. Completing all divisions from their current rank or being demoted from all divisions will result in promotion to the next rank or demotion to the previous rank.
In Mythic, stars have been replaced with points to advance to the next division.

sections.titre: Star Raising and Star Protection Points

elements.texte: There are many methods to increase or prevent star loss, leading to star elevation and protection points.

Star Raising allows players to earn an additional star when a player reaches 100% Star Raising Points on their next victory. 100/200/300/500/700/1000 points required at Warrior / Elite / Master / Grandmaster / Epic / Legend. Star increase bonus points cannot be accumulated in Mythic ranks.

Star Protection allows players to avoid losing a star in a match by reaching 100% Star Protection points or using Star Protection cards. 100/200/300/500/700/1000/1500 points required at Warrior / Elite / Master / Grandmaster / Epic / Legend / Mythic.
Star Protection Cards are usually obtained through in-game events or through Starlight Rewards. They generally only last 7 days once obtained or claimed on the event pages.
The rank protection card is the card that prevents you from demoting once you reach the previous rank. It is often acquired after reaching a higher rank: from Epic to Legend, from Legend to Mythic.
Only Star Protection Points are available in Mythic, as Star Obtaining Points are disabled.

Rank protection cards can only be obtained from rank promotion rewards. Unlike star protection points/cards, they only activate on defeats that will result in a player being demoted (for example, a defeat resulting in a loss of stars from Legend V 0 stars to Epic I 4 stars, demoting from Legend rank to Epic rank).
Once the season ends, all players will start their new season with their new rank based on their ranking from the previous season. They also receive the reward for reaching a certain rank.
The ranking reset is only applied when the player logs in for the first time in the new season, but their old ranking is not saved in the leaderboard.

description: Brawl is a game mode in which you cannot freely choose your heroes. Instead, each player will have two random heroes to choose from. Battles in this mode take place only on a single lane with two turrets defending the base in both teams respectively. Brawl matches generally end in a much shorter time than Classic Mode and Ranked Mode. This type of match is preferred for increasing lost credit scores or completing tasks.

elements.texte: Each player has the choice between 2 random heroes.
Players can only purchase items once they die or before leaving the altar area each time they respawn.
The altar no longer heals or regenerates mana. All healing effects are halved. The base is no longer restocking.
Each hero can have an additional buff or handicap.
Players can chat during the selection phase.
All players start at level 4 and receive 2,500 starting gold to purchase items. Once they leave the base, they must die to be able to purchase items again.
Heroes who rarely die in combat will drop a healing glyph. (Heals both Max HP and Mana.)
Turrets in Brawl behave the same as in classic games. However the turrets are weaker and do not have a golden shield.
The second turret on each side releases a wave that kills all minions when destroyed.
Gold and experience gained from minions are higher than in classic mode.
After 12 minutes, the Super Minions are deployed to avoid long games.

There are two crabs on opposite sides of the path that spawn at 0:30 and respawn 30 seconds after dying. Killing a Frozen Crab regenerates small amounts of health, gives gold and a small shield. Nearby allies who help with the crab also receive gold. This crab can be used as a springboard for heroes like Lancelot, Joy or Natalia, interact with certain heroes like Vexana, Benedetta or Yi Sun-shin, or check if the enemy is in the nearest bush or kill yourself to buy items when their health is too low.

There are two healing runes on opposite sides of the path that appear at 0:30 and reappear 35 seconds after being collected. The timer and sound effect are visible and audible to everyone. The rune continuously heals the picker for the 5 second delay, then regenerates some health and up to 40% mana to all allied heroes within range. If the recoverer dies during the delay, the healing is canceled.
There is a barrel on each side that appears at 0:20 and every 30 seconds after being picked up. Pick this barrel and shoot at the enemies to surprise them!

The barrel makes the user untargetable shortly, deals true damage, and has a 15 second cooldown, making it impossible to pull off two barrels at once. When someone picks up a barrel, a sound is made, audible to everyone on the map.
The Barrel is also disabled by rooted effect.
A dead Diggie or an untargetable hero can collect the barrel.

Unlike Classic or Ranked modes, there are no rank restrictions in Brawl. This means you can queue up matches where one side is a 5-man solo queue while the other is a team of 5, or one side is a 5-man Mythic Immortal while the other is someone who just downloaded the game.
Being AFK, avoiding team fights or verbal abuse is entirely punishable through reporting.
Recommended team composition

There are many heroes to choose from with different playstyles. Knowing the heroes' skills, strengths, and weaknesses as well as their optimal positioning is essential. Prioritize Assassins, Mages, or Fighters as they deal a lot of damage and provide crowd control. Avoid Marksman as they are item dependent and fragile at first, unless they have good minion clearing and area of ​​effect abilities like Beatrix or Granger. Avoid teams with too many Mages, too many Snipers, or too many Tanks.
Recommended Combat Spells
Flameshot has a very low cooldown and can be used to check the bush, secure kills, or negate abilities.
At least one player must bring the following:
Revitalize so their team can sustain after the fight as the altar no longer heals, especially when your team is in a bad position and can't secure healing runes; And
Purify, if your hero has good damage but is vulnerable to crowd control (CC).
However, Sprint is not highly recommended.
Enjoy the crowd
Brawl's unique card can massively buff heroes such as Luo Yi, Odette, Lancelot, Xavier, Fanny while heroes who rely too much on basic attacks like Freya or Thamuz become useless.
Likewise, you will need to avoid staying close to each other when the enemies are Atlas or Tigreal.
Buy the right things

Instead of purchasing a decent item, purchasing smaller components might give a better advantage. You can also wait a few seconds and send a message to your allies that you are almost enough gold to purchase items.j
Instead of rushing a 5-man team with full Sky Piercer, a healing-reducing item can greatly counter the enemy team.
Hidden in the bush
Take advantage of the bushes to ambush enemies, especially suitable for heroes like Helcurt, Hilda, Natalia, Luo Yi. Be careful if enemies have such heroes.
Replay hero selection

At the start, players will have the choice between 2 heroes. If no hero really suits you, you roll a die to obtain a new hero and send your discarded hero to the reserve for the others. Sometimes just one discarded hero is enough for everyone to swap. You can chat and ask other players or use quick chats and emotes. Keep in mind that if the hero is discarded twice and disappears from everyone's selection, he might reappear if you use another die, which would waste your dice. Up to 10 heroes can appear on the abandoned location.
Some heroes are difficult for you to play, but that doesn't mean it's difficult for your allies, swap them and avoid accumulating two good heroes while your allies have none.
Enlist the enemy
Since there is only one lane, it's easier to guess your opponents' moves and place your hero in the best position to defend or attack.
When the enemy team has Xavier, Novaria, expect you to be damaged or revealed by purchasing items from the altar or reaching the battlefield.
You can check enemies' items to see if they have left their altar or not.
Use natural objects

You can save a barrel to escape after a dive, turret dive, or use it to shorten the distance with Flicker. Barrels first appear at 20 seconds, while the first healing runes last for 30 seconds. It's best to secure the bush to the right and the glyph nearby, so your team can at least turn off a healing option after the enemies fight. Use the barrel to stop enemies when they try to secure the healing rune.
All heroes receive Flicker by default alongside another chosen combat spell.
All combat spells start on 50% of their normal cooldown.
As some heroes will be too powerful or too disadvantaged in Brawl, certain buffs or handicaps are added to certain heroes as follows:
Latest version: v350.1 {|class="article-table" !Heroes!!Stat changes!!Individual changes
Passive gain: 10/4
There are four doors for Chip, each side has one near the base, while the other two are on either side of the opposite bushes.

description: The "Vs A.I" mode in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang was introduced towards the end of 2017, shortly after the game's global release. Originally featuring only easy and normal difficulties, the mode underwent significant upgrades, including a hard mode added during Project Next in 2020 and a modernized and challenging AI. training methods published around November 2023.

elements.texte: There are three game modes you can choose in this mode: Classic, Brawl, and Draft Pick.
There are also three difficulty levels: AI: Simple, AI: Normal, and AI: Hard.
AI:Easy has a very simple AI, ideal for practicing a hero you have just unlocked or don't know yet.

AI: Normal has slightly more advanced AI opponents who can sometimes pose a threat when farming, use their skills carefully. This difficulty is a bit more complex than AI: simple and a much better option for training a hero in near-real combat.

AI:Hard has moderately advanced AI opponents who know when to use their combat spells and time their skills correctly to kill their opponent. They also attack turrets correctly, unlike normal and simple where they die on purpose, they also know how to macro and track their team, and actually know how to escape, it is recommended to use the main hero.

description: Custom games are very similar to Vs. AI. The difference is that players are pitted against other people or AI. Players can invite friends to join the game or add AI with existing buttons. Players can also add an AI to the opposing team or your team, you can also play alone with an AI.

elements.texte: Custom mode will not affect your rank, hero mastery, or placement. You will also not gain any BP or EXP.

If you have trial cards with heroes that you don't yet have Draft Pick, there is still a bug that allows you to use that trial card with the hero you still don't have, the trial card will not be consumed/used.
Most players usually use customization to compete in 1v1 or organize custom matches between 2 teams (tournaments).
Source: https://youtu.be/3mFb0EQrMXE?t=113
Category:Custom Category:Game Mode

description: Arcade modes are an additional game mode in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang that can be played from time to time during special events, holidays, or occasions. The mode features various strategy-based subgames, listed below.

elements.texte: Intense, fast and exciting 5v5 arcade!

In the past, this game didn't really have an official name. This game mode was first released and it was simply the Summer Carnival that arrived and contained consumables to improve the heroes' skills, with a modified map corresponding to Summer. During Halloween, this mode returned with the same features as Summer Carnival, modified skills, bonus candies, and Halloween-themed map. Then Christmas came and the mode had the same features; However, even though the map was changed to fit Christmas, the candies were kept as consumables. And then Easter came. Finally, Mayhem mode was introduced: this time the game mode had no consumables, but it had modified skills and map changes.
There are only 50 heroes available in this mode.
Duels of the same hero but using different tactics!

Mirror mode uses the same map as Bruno Cup Mayhem mode (in fact, the map layout, Lord and minions have the same theme), however, during the selection phase, in each team, players will vote for one from six randomly chosen heroes. Whoever gets the most votes will be the hero chosen for their entire team. Similar to Mayhem mode, players will start at hero level 4 and receive 900 gold. As in all game modes, the objective is to destroy the enemy base.
Will you be the one who lasts until the last?

Survival is similar to any other Battle Royale game, but with a few tweaks to fit Mobile Legends. Survival only works with teams of 3 players in a 99 player battle (33 teams) and the map will not be the Heavenly Palace or the Western Expanse, as in other game modes, instead it will be set on a single map, Minos' Labyrinth, which is a very large map to accommodate 99 players. Survival only offers 15 selectable heroes, dividing them into three groups of 5: Physical, Magic and Defense. Looting in this game mode is different from Battle Royales: you have to kill Creeps/Jungle Monsters to make them drop items, and there are 4 new Creeps in this game mode, each with different chances of dropping items for the three categories. To learn more about this game mode, click on the highlighted text above.
Enter Eruditio and strive to be the last one standing.

In recent times, a most fascinating competition, whose popularity is growing day by day, has taken Eruditio by storm. Known as “Survival: Nexus,” it attracts participants from across Eruditio. Convenient terminals allow participants to control Beatrix's virtual avatars using only their brain waves, immersing themselves in a virtual realm. Here they can participate in a tactical competition in which the last player standing receives a huge reward. Seize your chance while you can, adventurers, and join Survival: Nexus!
Play different heroes in one match!

This is another type of game in Mobile Legends, selection is very similar to survival in which the player has to choose a hero from the randomly selected heroes whether he owns it or not. In gameplay, when the hero dies, the player must choose another hero. If two players have chosen the same hero, they must choose another. There are two ways to achieve victory: either destroy the enemy base or achieve 30 victories before the enemy. In 2019, it is released in coordination with the Spring Festival. The battlefield therefore rises to the occasion.

In this mode, various food items can be found in the mode. By collecting different food items, players can obtain different buffs that improve their hero abilities. Some achievements are exclusive to Frenzy mode and can only be obtained by playing this mode.
Food items can be found where some of the creeps are killed, where some of the special minions are killed, where the enemy heroes are killed, and at supply points inside the house and enemy base.
List of food products
It was released on April 20, 2019.

In this game mode, 15 players are dropped onto a map where they must level up and evolve by collecting gems dropped by monsters or randomly appearing on the map, with the goal of being the last player standing. Killing an enemy player will not eliminate them, rather they will suffer a respawn time penalty and lose experience; however, once the first player reaches level 15 and becomes the "Devil", all deaths are permanent.

Monsters will also drop colored gems that permanently increase stats: red gems increase physical attack, blue gems increase magic attack, and green gems increase HP. Different monsters drop different gems. Some higher level monsters will also drop combat spells to equip; Only one can be equipped at a time, as one is already given upon reaching level 6.
There is no champion select screen, all players start as level 1 “Cells” and can progress by reaching certain experience levels.
Level 1: Cells
They can't attack and have low health, but since everyone started in this state, this isn't a problem. They are also the fastest monsters.
Monsters will not appear at this point in the game.
Level 3: Minions
Once reaching level 3, players can choose to evolve into Basic Minion, Ranged Minion, or Ballista Minion.
In addition to having a different attack and speed, this choice also affects all subsequent available evolutions.
After 1 minute, monsters start appearing. At this point, only blue and red gelatins will appear, but they will not attack players.
Level 6: Minor Monsters
Players will evolve into different monsters depending on the minion they choose. Minor monsters will each have a skill.
Physical course: If the player chose Basic Minion, he will evolve into Giant Mouth or Crammer.
:1. Giant Mouth's skill will deal damage to an enemy equal to a percentage of the target's max HP.
:2. Crammer's skill will significantly increase his lifesteal for a while.
Magical journey: If the player chose Ranged Minion, he will evolve into a Goblin or Crimson Lizard.
:1. The Goblin's skill will throw a very damaging ball of energy in one direction.
:2. Crimson Lizard's skill will create a zone of energy that continuously deals damage to enemies inside.
Route Tank: If the player chose Ballista Minion, it will evolve into Spinner or Death.
:1. Spinner's skill will instantly regenerate a certain amount of HP.
:2. Death skill will continuously deal damage to surrounding enemies.
When reaching level 6, players can also choose one of two random combat spells to equip for the remainder of the match. Possible combat spells are Flicker, Sprint, Execute, Inspire, and Aegis.
Level 9: Major Monsters Major monsters will have two skills, many of which are inspired by skills of existing heroes or attacks that these monsters perform in other game modes.
If the player chose the Physical path, he will evolve into a Gargoyle or Cleaver.
: 1. Gargoyle skill 1 will increase his movement speed for a while, skill 2 will increase his attack.
:2. Cleaver's skill 1 is a flicker similar to Flicker, his skill 2 is his signature delayed wave attack from other game modes.
If the player has chosen the Magic path, he will evolve into a Pioneer or a Statued Chaser.
:1. Pioneer's skill 1 launches an orb that will block enemies similar to Cyclops Ultimate, skill 2 is his poison trap characteristic of other game modes, but in a straight line.

:2. Statued Chaser skill 1 is similar to Gusion's first skill (they will throw a dagger in one direction, and if it hits an enemy, the skill can be used again to chase them); skill 2 will attack enemies in front of it, dealing high damage.
If the player chose the Tank evolution, he will evolve into Statued Shocker or Core Guard.

: 1. The Statued Shocker's skill 1 will enhance his next basic attack, which will stun enemies; skill 2 will provide them with a shield that will explode after a certain amount of time or when destroyed, similar to Uranus' second skill.
:2. Core Guard skill 1 will taunt nearby enemies, forcing them to attack, skill 2 will reflect damage received for a certain time. (Both skills resemble Gatotkaca's second skill.)
Upon reaching level 9, players can also choose one of two passive buffs that last the rest of the match, depending on their path:
Physical Buffs: 30% Attack Damage or 40% Attack Speed
Magic Buffs: 40% CD reduction or 40% Spell Vamp
Tank Buffs: 2% of health converted to damage or recovers 300 HP every 5 seconds
Once at least one player has reached level 9, minor monsters will also start appearing as monsters; they will attack players if provoked and drop more gems.
A “black turtle” may also appear. It can drop large quantities of large gems. Its location will be visible on each player's map.
Tier 12: Hero (Need more info: Available heroes may specifically change based on Tier 6 and Tier 9 routes. More heroes may be available than listed.)
If the player chose the physical path, Marksman or Assassin heroes will be available.
: Sniper: Karrie, Lesley, Bruno, Claude.
: Assassins: Lancelot, Saber, Freya.
If the player chose the magic path, Mage or Support heroes will be available.
: Mage: Odette, Gord, Alice, Esmeralda, Harley.
: Support: Angela, Estes, Nana.
If the player chose the Tank evolution, Fighter or Tank heroes will be available.
: Fighter: Kaja, Lapu Lapu, Alucard.
: Reservoir: Hylos, Uranus, Akai, Jhonson.

When the first player reaches level 13, major monsters will start appearing. They can drop larger gems that are worth more than normal gems, and even equipable combat spells. Large experience gems will also start to appear.
Level 15: The Devil

The first player to reach level 15 will become the Devil. They will get bigger and their stats will increase, but they will move slower and their position will be revealed on all other players' maps. They will also have the ability to transform into a Lord for a time, gaining powerful new skills that resemble the Lord's attack from other game modes.

: Skill 1 and Skill 2, "Lord Strikes": Pounds the ground heavily, dealing real damage to surrounding enemies and leaving a crack beneath their current position; after a while, the crack will explode, dealing damage and knocking down enemies.
: Skill 3, "Spinning Strikes": After charging for a short time, the Lord will spin his hammer, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies in a wide area.
Any other player reaching level 15 will not become the Devil: the only way to claim the title and buffs is to kill the current Devil.

In this final stage, the safe zone will begin to slowly shrink, forming a circle centered on the current "Devil" and forcing other players to move closer to them. the area will move with the Devil, trying to keep them in its center. Now killing a player will eliminate them from the match.
Sci-fi style scrambling battle.

The mysterious rift in the parallel universe is gradually widening. A Zlatan airship is about to crash into the Land of Dawn, which would be a disaster and a challenge! Warriors, Ravage is now open. Show your courage and strength to save Zlatan and defend the Land of Dawn.

Ravage is a mode in which each team consists of 5 different roles and fights for the Aquamarines. Each player can choose 5 heroes with different roles before participating in a Ravage match. After the confrontation, each player randomly uses one of the 5 heroes they chose previously.

In this mode, S.A.B.E.R. and V.E.N.O.M. are fighting. As they fight, aquamarines begin to fall around them. The first team to collect a certain amount of Aquamarine will win the match. Being eliminated causes the player to lose all aquamarines, which scatter on the ground. If a player has more than 10 aquamarines, their location will be exposed on the mini-map.

In the center of the Ravage mode map is the only HP regeneration point. Once eliminated, players quickly respawn in the Control Center and can rejoin the battle very quickly. Eliminating enemies and collecting their aquamarines is the goal of this mode.
The first team to accumulate 15 Aquamarines will win this match. No laning, no destructive turrets, killing and ravaging is the goal of this mode! Come have fun, you will be the winner!
From August 7 to 13, 2020, Ravage mode returned with a new 3V3 mode. Only 3 out of 5 roles will be used and all players will start with 30,000 and a hero level of 15 (max).
Exciting brawling match between mirrored heroes!
Hero Selection: In this mode, players vote for the hero they want to use from a random set of heroes. The hero with the most votes will become the hero used by the entire team.
Hero Adjustment: In this mode, different heroes receive different attribute upgrades to create more balance between heroes of different roles, improving the overall gaming experience.
Tower Defense Battle Royale Match

Harper, who was venturing into the southern Abyss, inadvertently enters the Abyss. He discovers that demons led by the name =Dyrroth are gathering in the Abyss. Soon, they will cross Lantis Mountain and destroy the Moniyan Empire. However, any creatures that get in the way will suffer from the catastrophe.

CHESS-TD is an Arcade mode full of fun and strategy! In this mode, 6 will be spread across 6 maps and will face each other as well as creeps. Players can purchase heroes from the store, purchase their own roster, loot gold, and upgrade their troops to achieve victory.

The map is random for each match. Players can purchase Heroes from the store and deploy them on stones higher than the ground (slots). Deployed heroes will automatically attack nearby enemies and cast their skill once they gain enough mana.

Definition of the round: A round contains 4 phases: the preparation phase, the preparation phase, the combat phase and the resolution phase. The preparation phase involves players buying, deploying, recalling or selling heroes and improving their ability. During the combat phase, one of the other players' heroes will invade your map. If these invaders reach their destination before being eliminated, you will suffer relative damage.

Gold and Ability Definition: At the end of each round, players will receive a certain amount of gold and interest (for every 10 gold coins owned, get 1 extra gold coin). Additionally, getting winning streaks or losing streaks will also grant additional gold bonus. Capacity decides how many heroes you can deploy. The maximum is 9. At the end of each round, you will get 1 Ability Exp. Additionally, you can choose to purchase 4 Exp Abilities. with 4 gold medals. The chance of obtaining elite heroes increases with the ability level, at the same time, the chance of obtaining common heroes decreases with it.

Hero Level and Star: There are 4 levels for heroes, which indicate their rarity and cost. Generally speaking, high level heroes should be more powerful. If there are 3 same heroes on the battlefield, they will become a higher level hero. Three 1-star heroes will become one 2-star hero. Three 2-star heroes will become one 3-star hero.

Synergy: Each hero has 2 attributes: faction and role. The synergy effect will be activated if there are enough heroes with the same attributes on the battlefield (the attributes of the same heroes will only be counted once). It is important to take synergy into account.
Fast automatic chess competition between 8 players.

Magic Chess is a complex 8-player strategy game mode, in which players will compete against each other and against random monsters on the magic chessboard. The goal of this game is to purchase and upgrade your heroes and the Little Commander, customizing your alignment to trigger and counter more and stronger synergies. Victory belongs to the one who holds out to the last!
The fight on the bridge of destruction.

In Shadow Brawl, players vote to select a hero from several randomly appearing heroes. All players on the team will use the same hero to play. Players are equipped with name=Blade of Silence which marks the current position and connects a chain to it. The chain will automatically return your hero to the marked position after 4 seconds. The CD is 20 seconds long.
Automatic 1v1 card battle.

A new type of game has taken Moniyan by storm. The Little Commanders and their magical items can now be found in every house in the land. Crystal balls detect all kinds of life in the Land of Dawn and channel their energy; which turns into collectible cards. There are Monster cards and Hero cards. Monsters are easy to earn and control, while heroes require a higher price and more advanced energy. Decks are built and battles are fought with others; people strive to defeat the little enemy commander and achieve victory.

In "Arena" mode, you will face another player in a 1v1 battle. Your objective is simple: eliminate your opponent's Little Commander before he takes down yours. To do this, you will need to use cards to summon Heroes and Monsters and cast spells to fight against your opponent's troops. The battle will continue until the Little Commander on one side is eliminated. “Shard”, the resource for summoning monsters and using spells, is generated every 3 seconds. And by spending 5 “Shards”, the resource used to summon Heroes, “Essence”, will be generated.

After entering the "Arena", you will receive a series of tutorials to help you get started. After going through the full tutorial, you will be rewarded with 9 basic cards. As you play, you can obtain cards from Battle Chests and Summon Orbs. The duplicate cards obtained will be used to improve the corresponding cards to give it more strength. Additionally, more cards will be unlocked as you progress in your ranking. All cards will be unlocked when legend is reached. There are two rarity levels for Hero cards: Uncommon and Epic. There are two maps, Uncommon and Epic. There are also two rarity levels for Monster/Spell cards: Common and Uncommon.
You can earn Cup Points, Battle Points and Battle Chests after each match. More cards can be unlocked with more cup points. You can get battle points or already unlocked cards from battle chests.

A fascinating competition called Boommander is now trending in Laladona, and many Little Commanders have become its fans. The rules are simple: collect Fluffy that grows in the oasis near the Origin Tree and throw these explosive balls at the others. Can you dodge attacks and blast your opponent? Join Boommander and try it now! In Boommander mode, you play as little commanders and launch Fluffy to compete on maps reconstituted with different scene tiles.
